PromptCapabilities.description:
Prompt capabilities supported by the agent in `session/prompt` requests.

Baseline agent functionality requires support for [`ContentBlock::Text`]
and [`ContentBlock::ResourceLink`] in prompt requests.

Other variants must be explicitly opted in to.
Capabilities for different types of content in prompt requests.

Indicates which content types beyond the baseline (text and resource links)
the agent can process.

SessionCapabilities.description:
Session capabilities supported by the agent.

As a baseline, all Agents **MUST** support `session/new`, `session/prompt`, `session/cancel`, and `session/update`.

Optionally, they **MAY** support other session methods and notifications by specifying additional capabilities.

Note: `session/load` is still handled by the top-level `load_session` capability. This will be unified in future versions of the protocol.

See protocol docs: [Session Capabilities](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/initialization#session-capabilities)

limitations: Exact ACP schema 0.11.4 (v0.11.4, e9313572), the dependency of the nearest public Grok mirror commit. The binary embeds agent-client-protocol-0.10.4 (binary probe), and every captured 1.0.70 carrier validates against it; the schema is not the binary's own source.

The result schema is allOf(exact ACP, sampled Grok 1.0.70 instance): the sampled branch records Grok's observed extension fields. Sampled from the Grok 1.0.70 darwin-arm64 census: observed JSON types per field, with required fields present in every captured instance. Sanitized strings keep their type but not their value, so enumerations and formats are not inferred.
The carrier fixes the JSON-RPC envelope and method; params are validated by the payload schema.

notes: Advertises loadSession, sessionCapabilities {list, resume, close}, mcpCapabilities {http, sse}, and promptCapabilities {image: true (false in 1.0.0), audio: false, embeddedContext: true}; authMethods are [xai.api_key, grok.com]. Grok-specific `_meta` carries the cwd, agentVersion, a stable machine-derived agentId (UUIDv5), a per-process agentInstanceId, hostname, modelState, availableCommands, and feature flags. sessionCapabilities.additionalDirectories is not advertised even though the CLI gained --add-dir.
